description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Customs Ordinance. Payment of the Customs Import Duty. Order Under Section - 19A
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order issued under Section 19(A) of the Customs Ordinance that grants customs duty exemptions for various government projects. It contains statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements related to customs duties, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
